fields.name: type
fields.label: Type
fields.description: Optional media to display above the question.

name: question
label: Question
description: The objectively gradable question shown above the numerical scale.

name: acceptedTolerance
label: Accepted tolerance (±)
description: The accepted interval extends equally above and below the reference answer. Every selectable slider position inside the inclusive interval is correct. Zero requires an exact selectable answer. A positive tolerance allows the reference answer itself to fall between selectable positions.

name: customPoints
label: Custom points
description: You control the point order; Scale Question does not sort the list. For numerical or chronological scales, enter points from highest/latest at the top to lowest/earliest at the bottom. Vertical questions display this authored order from top to bottom. Horizontal questions display it in reverse from left to right, placing lower/earlier points on the left and higher/later points on the right. Vertical orientation is generally preferable when a scale contains more than approximately six points or relatively long point labels. Select exactly one point as correct. Reordering a point also moves its correct-answer setting.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Value
fields.description: Required display value. It is treated as text and is not sorted or interpreted numerically.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Optional additional context shown with the value.

fields.name: correct
fields.label: Correct point
fields.description: Exactly one custom point must be marked correct.

name: feedbackBelowCorrect
label: Feedback for an answer below the correct position
description: Optional feedback for an answer that is too low or too early. For example: “Too early! Try a later date.” or “Too low! Try a higher value.”

name: feedbackAboveCorrect
label: Feedback for an answer above the correct position
description: Optional feedback for an answer that is too high or too late. For example: “Too late! Try an earlier date.” or “Too high! Try a lower value.”

fields.name: autoCheck
fields.label: Automatically check answers after selection
fields.description: When enabled, the learner's answer is checked immediately after selecting a value or point. The Check button is not displayed. When disabled, the learner must click Check to submit an answer.
